decision.explanation: The documents present two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding Albignac's electoral district. Document 1 (D1) contains a narrative where characters explicitly state Albignac is part of the 'canton of Bapaume' (D1S7, D1S9, D1S20). Document 2 (D2) presents a factual-style entry stating Albignac is part of the 'canton of Midi Corrézien' (D2S4, D2S7). Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers without resolving contradictions silently, both asserted districts are included as they represent distinct claims found in the source text.
